ARE YOU LICENSED AND INSURED?
Yes, we're a fully licensed, insured, and bonded electrical contractor serving Aurora and surrounding areas with complete peace of mind protection.
WHAT ELECTRICAL SERVICES DO YOU OFFER?
We provide comprehensive residential, commercial, industrial, and emergency electrical services including repairs, installations, and electrical system upgrades throughout Aurora, Illinois.
HOW LONG HAS AURORA ELECTRIC BEEN IN BUSINESS?
Aurora Electric has been serving the community for over 30 years, with our team bringing more than 40 years of electrical experience to every project.
DO YOU PROVIDE EMERGENCY ELECTRICAL SERVICES?
Yes, we offer 24/7 emergency electrical services to ensure fast, reliable solutions for urgent electrical issues that can't wait until business hours.
WHAT AREAS DO YOU SERVE?
We primarily serve Aurora, Illinois and the surrounding areas, providing electrical services to both residential and commercial properties in the region.
CAN YOU HANDLE COMMERCIAL ELECTRICAL PROJECTS?
Absolutely. We specialize in commercial electrical services including installations, repairs, and system upgrades for businesses and commercial properties of all sizes.
WHAT MAKES AURORA ELECTRIC DIFFERENT?
We're a family-owned business with over 40 years of experience, fully licensed and bonded, providing trusted electrical services to Aurora homes and businesses.
DO YOU WORK ON INDUSTRIAL ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS?
Yes, our experienced team handles industrial electrical services including complex rewiring, panel upgrades, and specialized electrical installations for industrial facilities.
HOW CAN I CONTACT AURORA ELECTRIC?
You can reach us at (630) 892-6522 or email tech@auroraelectricinc.com. We're available 24/7 for emergency electrical services throughout Aurora, Illinois.
WHAT'S INCLUDED IN RESIDENTIAL ELECTRICAL SERVICES?
Our residential services include electrical repairs, installations, outlet and switch work, panel upgrades, and electrical system troubleshooting for homes throughout Aurora.
